description.text: Ophthalmology is a clinical discipline that studies the anatomy, physiology, and pathology of visual organs (the eyeball, ocular appendages, and related nervous systems), as well as the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of ocular diseases. As an important branch of the medical field, it not only involves microsurgical techniques (such as cataract surgery and corneal transplantation), but also covers the drug treatment of intraocular diseases (such as glaucoma and diabetic retinopathy), and intersects with neuroscience, genetics and other fields, dedicated to protecting and restoring human visual function.

duration.text: The Ophthalmology at Xi'an Jiaotong University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

Study or research plan in ChinaApplicants are required to submit a study or research plan in China written in either Chinese or EnglishSwipe. Research achievementsPublished papers, award certificates, invention patents, etc. prove one's academic achievementsInformation on achievements and research capabilities. 10. Copy of a valid ordinary passportThe validity period of the passport should be later than September 2025 If it does not meet the requirements, please contact us promptlyA new passport will be issued when necessary

requirements.text: 1. Non-chinese citizens in good health;2. Degree and age requirementsApplicants to study for a master's degree in China must have a bachelor's degree and be under the age of 1835 years old;Those who come to China to pursue a doctoral degree must have a master's degree and be no older than the required ageForty years old.3. Not other scholarship recipients
